description: An account settings page with a profile sidebar and a Sign-In and Security section of editable cards.
overview: An account settings page with a profile header and a sidebar of sections. Only Sign-In and Security is filled in: email and phone cards that expand into an inline edit form, a Passkeys switch, a two-factor row and a confirmation after each save, while the other sections show a placeholder. It uses `AppShell` with an off-canvas sidebar. Use it as the frame for any account or profile settings.
usage: Load the email, phone and profile details from the signed-in user, and replace the `onSave` handler with your account API. Add content for the remaining sections listed in `items`. The profile name, email and initials in the header are hard-coded.
notes: Collapsed edit forms are `inert`, focus moves to the input when a card opens, and save confirmations are announced.
